┌─ Help: Mobs and difficulty ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ What mobs do                                                                                                                             │
│   Difficulty: each mob is trivial, easy, even, hard or deadly to you, by its level against yours (Nearby and the Target panel say it in  │
│   words). Trivial mobs leave you alone and drop nothing rare; deadly ones are four or more levels above you.                             │
│   Casters: a mob's bolt takes a few seconds to cast. A stun or an interrupting blow (a warrior's Bash) breaks it off, and the log says   │
│   "your Bash breaks off the hexer's bolt".                                                                                               │
│   Healers: a shaman heals the mob it fights beside. The log says who heals whom; kill the healer first, or break its cast.               │
│   Fleeing: a hurt goblin runs for home once, then turns back to fight. Follow it, or let it go: it comes back by itself.                 │
│   Linked camps: pulling one mob can bring its partner camp, and a chief's cry can call the guards of his wing. The log says "joins the   │
│   fight" or "answers" for each.                                                                                                          │
